data.title: Migrate parallax.studio label → parallax across content

data.body: Swept parallax.studio label -> parallax across 12 src/content/now/*.mdx frontmatter values + docs/site-update-guide.md (allowed-values list, MDX example, TS-shape comment, project reference table). Also updated the guide's L3 intro prose from parallax.studio -> parallax.haus (stale domain ref, slightly beyond enumerated doc lines - flagged in report). Chose label value 'parallax' (domain-agnostic; renders as a mono metadata tag beside siblings architecture/personal, reads consistently). Verified: no parallax.studio in ts/tsx; env fallback in src/lib/metadata.ts already https://parallax.haus. pnpm build PASS, pnpm lint PASS (only pre-existing warnings). NOT committed - left staged for Julianna's review. Awaiting her review + commit approval.
